title: KirbSMP
description: A curated Vanilla+ Modpack for the private KirbSMP server that keeps modern Minecraft fresh!
body:
# KirbSMP

**Recommended: 4-6GB RAM**

A 1.20.1 Vanilla+ modpack for personal use and the private KirbSMP server. This modpack was designed to make modern Minecraft feel fresh again without straying too far from its roots.


Notable Features:
- Optimized Performance
- Distant Horizons (Default: 64 Chunks)
- Enhanced Visuals & Sounds
- New World Generation, Biomes & Structures
- Advanced Machines with 'Create'
- Cooking with 'Farmer's Delight'
- Photography with 'Exposure'
- Various new Blocks & Items
- Controller Support
- Integrated Voice Chat
- Disabled Telemetry
- And much more!
